This application coming on for orders this day, 
 following:
 ORDER
This is second application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of temporary bail on the ground of marriage of his sister.

He is in custody in connection with FIR No.644/2023 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Station Road, Ratlam (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 366-a, 376(2), 376(3) of the IPC and section 3/4 and 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
The first bail application was dismissed as Signing time: 2/15/2024 5:26:48 withdrawn with liberty to renew the prayer after filing of the court statement of prosecutrix.

sentences.text: 2. Counsel for the applicant submits that the marriage of sister of the applicant namely Manisha is scheduled to take place on 19.2.2024 and the functions will start from 17.2.2024.
Along with the application, the marriage card and affidavit of father of applicant are enclosed.
3. Counsel for the State prays for time to verify the same.

4. After hearing learned counsel for parties and taking into consideration the marriage card of applicant's and affidavit of father, the present application for temporary bail is allowed subject to verification of factum of marriage of sister of applicant by the trial court.

In case if the same is found to be correct, then the applicant shall be released on temporary bail for the period from 17.2.2024 to 20.2.2024 upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court below on the condition that the applicant shall surrender before the concerned Court on 21.2.2024.
During this period, the applicant shall not approach and influence the prosecutrix or her witnesses.
5. In case if he fails to surrender on 21.2.2024, the concerned Court shall take necessary steps to arrest the applicant in accordance with the law.
6. A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the court below.
C.c. as per rules.
